text:
jamal: quick alert - postdeploy synthetic on /v1/rerank in us-west2 shows elevated 429s starting at 18:32Z. baseline ~0.3% -> observed 4.8%. happened right after canary shift.

deploy-bot: Deploy event: release-2026-03-22-2 started 2026-03-22T18:05Z. Targets: api-prod. Rollout: 70% (canary -> global). Postdeploy checks: ALERT. https://deploy/release-2026-03-22-2

nora: pulled traces - 429s map to reranker backends on us-west2-a and us-west2-b. proxy logs contain rate-limit reason header. not CPU or OOM. looks like token-bucket throttle triggered after batching change in new image.

li: log snippet from us-west2-a:
```
[2026-03-22T18:07:11Z] proxy pid=5521 WARN upstream=429 x-rw-reason=rate-limit route=/v1/rerank host=us-west2-a
[2026-03-22T18:07:11Z] reranker pid=3332 INFO batch_size=32 in_flight=120 tokens=5400
```

maria: can we narrow blast radius? options: 1) regional pin /v1/rerank to rerank-1.2, 2) reduce allowed concurrency in us-west2 via traffic shed, 3) rollback reranker image (last resort). prefer pin + small throttle.

devops-bot: mitigation recommendations:
- apply regional pin to stable model variant
- traffic adjust us-west2 -> 90% (shed 10%)
- if 429s persist after 15m escalate to rollback

jamal: executing regional pin + throttle now:
```
redwoodctl route pin --region us-west2 --route /v1/rerank --model rerank-1.2 --reason "postdeploy rate-limit regression" --by jamal
redwoodctl traffic adjust --region us-west2 --percent 90 --reason "temporary throttle to reduce burst during investigation"
```

deploy-bot: Action logged: /v1/rerank pinned to rerank-1.2 in us-west2 by jamal at 2026-03-22T18:12Z. Traffic adjusted: us-west2 -> 90%. Rollout paused at 70%.

health-bot: starting targeted smoke job: job-id=smoke-1845004444-rerank region=us-west2 samples=500 type=postdeploy-synth

li: I also soft-restarted reranker pods in us-west2-a to drain queues; no config or image changes. monitoring queue metrics.

health-bot: smoke progress: 250/500 sampled -> 429 rate dropped to 0.6% (was 4.8%). continuing to sample.

nora: good sign. please add a brief note in release notes and change window so SRE/support know this is intentional regional mitigation (no global rollback).

maria: adding to release notes: "release-2026-03-22-2: regional pin applied to /v1/rerank in us-west2 due to post-deploy rate-limit regressions observed in synthetic probes. Traffic throttled to 90% while reranker team investigates batching->token-bucket interplay. No global rollback."

jamal: smoke complete: 500 sampled, 3/500 429 (0.6%), p95=210ms, notes="pinned variant active; throttling in effect"

devops-bot: auto-policy: if 429s < 1% for 15m, system will resume rollout to 85% in region automatically. otherwise remain pinned and escalate.

li: creating reproducer locally with batching turned off and token-bucket settings copied from prod to see threshold differences. will populate ticket with logs and reproducer steps.

maria: holding rollout for 30m observation window; assigning reranker eng for RCA. if warmup or batching delta is root cause, add a canary preflight that verifies batch-concurrency vs token-bucket behavior.

nora: acknowledged. summary: regional pin + 10% throttle applied, soft-restart performed, smoke improved. collect telemetry for 30m then decide on staged resume. :thumbsup:
